==Summary==

{{pov|[[Elayne Trakand]]}}

Elayne begins to get dressed. Just as she finishes [[Birgitte Silverbow|Birgitte]] announces that [[Dyelin]] has returned with the [[High Seat|High Seats]] of four houses, which will bring her total to six houses, matching that of [[Arymilla]]. Elayne is surprised that the four high seats, [[Perival]], [[Catalyn]], [[Branlet]] and [[Conail]] are all teenagers but without guardians or others elders with them. Over three thousand useful troops came with the high seats, which will help greatly with manning the walls of the city.
